description: This is a unit test class for the ProjectDao within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It tests CRUD operations, query filtering, and report generation related to projects, project activities, and project admins.

classes.name: ProjectDaoTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the ProjectDao functionality related to project management, filtering, reporting, and access control within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ProjectDao instance, truncates specific tables, and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testAddProject
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new project, verifying the project instance and its name.

methods.name: testGetProjects
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of projects with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Tests filtering projects based on a customer or project name.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Tests filtering projects by excluding certain project IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectById
methods.description: Tests fetching a project by ID and verifying its properties.

methods.name: testUpdateProject
methods.description: Tests updating project properties and saving, then verifying changes.

methods.name: testDeleteProjects
methods.description: Tests deleting projects by IDs and verifying the delete count.

methods.name: testIsProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks whether the project name is already taken, given a project ID.

methods.name: testIsProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies whether specified employee IDs are project admins.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieving project IDs, including scenarios with deleted projects and empty results.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests getting project IDs accessible to a specific project admin, including various employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Verifies report generation criteria list and total hours calculation based on different filters.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Checks the count of report criteria list for specific filter settings.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies the list of employee numbers accessible to a project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests detailed activity reports for projects, filtering by activity ID, date ranges, and approval status, along with total hours.

search-terms: filter by customer or project name
